title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for chronic kidney disease.

HPI
The patient is a 62-year-old male presenting for a scheduled follow-up regarding his chronic kidney disease. He reports feeling generally well today with no new complaints of edema, fatigue, or changes in urinary output. He has been compliant with his prescribed medications and maintains a low-sodium diet. He notes that his energy levels remain stable despite the progression of his renal function.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10mg daily
Amlodipine 5mg daily

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. Vital signs are stable. Physical exam reveals no peripheral edema or uremic frost. Lungs are clear to auscultation. Heart sounds are regular with no murmurs. Skin is intact without signs of irritation.

Assessment
The patient has chronic kidney disease, currently classified as stage 3. Renal function is being monitored closely to manage progression.

Plan
Continue current medication regimen. Order laboratory work including serum creatinine and GFR to monitor chronic kidney disease status. Follow up in three months.
